sar.narrative: Customer C03633, holder of card C03633-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-25 21:00 and 2016-11-25 21:21, 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,935.29 were made on the card online from device profile 'MacOS | Mac OS X 10_8_5 | chrome 49.0 | 1280x800': $488.31 (3487284, 2016-11-25 21:00), $489.91 (3487318, 2016-11-25 21:10), $479.33 (3487340, 2016-11-25 21:18), $477.74 (3487348, 2016-11-25 21:21). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with deliberately staying under an authorisation threshold. The activity is suspicious because: Case-memory model score 0.352; 4 online purchases within 21 minutes, each between $400 and $500 ($488.31, $489.91, $479.33, $477.74; total $1,935.29). It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-3841, CC-4124, CC-3907. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placed linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.
